questions.question: Explain two aims of punishment and a religious view on each.

points.text: 1) Retribution — punishment that is proportionate to the crime because the offender deserves it. Christianity accepts retribution as justice but warns against revenge; Jesus replaced "an eye for an eye" with "turn the other cheek." 2) Reformation — punishment that helps the offender change and rejoin society.
